DDAVP, Desmoda (desmopressin) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-553396  
Guideline Name 
DDAVP, Desmoda (desmopressin)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
4/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Brand DDAVP tablets, generic desmopressin acetate tablets, generic 
desmopressin nasal spray, Desmoda oral solution  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - ONE of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of central diabetes insipidus  


=== PDF PAGE 448 ===
Page 448 
 
OR 
 
 1.2 Diagnosis of polyuria and/or polydipsia following head trauma or surgery in the pituitary 
region  
 
OR 
 
 1.3 Diagnosis of primary nocturnal enuresis  
 
AND 
 
2 - For Brand DDAVP ONLY: Trial and failure to generic desmopressin tablets (verified via 
paid pharmacy claims or submission of medical records)  
 
AND 
 
3 - For Desmoda requests ONLY: Trial and failure to BOTH of the following (verified via paid 
pharmacy claims or submission of medical records):  
• 
generic desmopressin tablets  
• 
generic desmopressin nasal spray  
Notes  
NOTE: Plan setup requires use of generic desmopressin tablets befor
e Brand DDAVP. Not all preferred products require Prior Authorization
 for FFS patients.

Date  
Notes

deline name.
